name: Exterior Soffit Interstage Inspection
intent: Inspect coat 1 for defects + touch-up. NO intercoat sanding — exterior rule: QT upgrades via prep/time-on-task, not interstage sand.
doctrine: Interstage between coat 1 and coat 2. Inspect qt_scaled (QT3:800, QT4:500 — overhead inspection slower due to awkward viewing angle, needs headlamp). Touch-up qt_scaled (QT3:1000, QT4:700). NO intercoat sanding on soffit per established exterior rule. Open-face modifier applies. All overhead rates baked in.
